rationale: The short thesis was premised on price fading below session VWAP ($42.95) and the 9-EMA ($42.92), but price has now reclaimed both at $43.11 with five consecutive rising 1m candles and expanding volume on the last bar (92k). With the original invalidation at $43.20 only ~9 cents away and momentum flipped against the position, the setup is broken; a long flip is not justified given the risk-off backdrop (SPY -0.81%, VIXY +2.06%) and the 12.5% gap that could easily re-fade.
